Pairing dialog not found. Make sure the headunit is on WiFi and the dialog is still open. You can also type the port and code, for example 37215 482913.
Pairing failed. Open \"Pair device with pairing code\" again and type the new code.
Paired, but ADB can\'t be reached yet. Make sure Wireless debugging is still on, then try again from KlikDash.
Open it over Wireless debugging
This headunit hasn\'t opened ADB to apps yet (port 5555). KlikDash can open it itself, without a computer:
Connect the headunit to WiFi, for example your phone\'s hotspot.
In Developer options, turn on Wireless debugging, then tap \"Pair device with pairing code\".
Leave the code dialog open. Pull down the notification panel, tap ENTER CODE on the KlikDash notification, and type the 6-digit code.
When it\'s done, Wireless debugging is turned off again automatically.
NEED HELP?
SCAN WITH YOUR PHONE FOR THE VIDEO TUTORIAL (INDONESIAN, SUBTITLED)
Power Saver needs port 5555 to stay open until the headunit restarts. Other devices on the same WiFi can reach that port: use it only on a private network.
WARNING: this headunit\'s ADB doesn\'t ask for permission. While port 5555 is open, anyone on the same WiFi can control the headunit without being asked.
